tools.name: get_dog_business
tools.description: Get details for one HundHubben business by its slug: description, address, contact info, categories, rating and review count.

tools.name: list_dog_events
tools.description: List upcoming published dog meetups (hundträffar) on HundHubben, optionally filtered by city.

tools.name: navigate_hundhubben
tools.description: Navigate the HundHubben site to a search, a business page or another in-app path.

tools.name: search_dog_businesses
tools.description: Search the HundHubben directory for dog businesses in Sweden (vets, daycares, groomers, trainers, boarding, breeders, dog parks) by free text and optional city. Matches business names as well as service categories such as 'hundfrisör' or 'veterinär'.

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'hundfrisör' or a business name.
